title: Jim's books documenting government-funded anomaly research (AAWSAP/BAASS era)

plain: A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says books by a writer he calls Jim, including follow-ups he thinks are called Future Visions and New Insights, fully document government-funded research at Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a ranch known for reports of strange events. He tells Michels the books record the anomalies and many witnesses from roughly 2008 onward, during a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained phenomena that was run through a private contractor, which, if true, would mean the government paid to investigate these events.
